body.description: LinkedIn adAnalytics Analytics Finder (q=analytics), daily creative performance (pivot=CREATIVE, timeGranularity=DAILY), feeding fact_creative_daily. Sources: the Reporting page at reference_url, served as li-lms-2026-09 (ms.date 2026-06-19, updated_at 2026-06-24), and the Metrics Available schema page https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads-reporting/ads-reporting-schema?view=li-lms-2026-09, served as li-lms-2026-09 (ms.date 2026-09-14, updated_at 2026-09-16), which types costInLocalCurrency as BigDecimal and the other requested metrics as long. No pagination per the page. The client follows a `next` link only if one ever appears. Otherwise, at 15,000 elements it splits the request by halving the date range. Date ranges are chunked so that creatives × days stays below 15,000 elements. An empty `elements` means no activity or no read access. Without `fields` only impressions and clicks are returned; up to 20 fields may be requested, and request.fields names 9. The 6-month daily retention caps backfill and any custom window at 180 days (AAP 0.2.4); performance data is otherwise retained 10 years and professional demographics 2 years, and timeGranularity=ALL ranges reaching past the daily retention round to month boundaries. The recovery probe sends this request with a one-day range (start equal to end). Throttled at 45 million metric values per 5 minutes. Request conventions: url is relative to https://api.linkedin.com/rest/; {acct} is urn%3Ali%3AsponsoredAccount%3A{id}; the Rest.li dateRange=(...) and List(...) keep literal parentheses, colons and commas; {fields} must equal request.fields exactly and is sent raw, not URL-encoded (an encoded projection is rejected with 400). dateRange.start and at least one facet (accounts, campaigns, campaignGroups, shares or companies) are required; this request uses accounts. pivotValues is a response field only, requested through fields and never a request parameter or filter; dateRange is both the required request date selector and a response field requested through fields.

elements.description: Report data points; at most 15,000 per response.

items.description: One report data point: one creative on one UTC day. Every metric is optional: an element may omit metrics (observed live 2026-10-07), and an absent metric is unavailable, never zero.

pivotValues.description: Values of the pivot for this data point (string[]). This product receives [creative URN], urn:li:sponsoredCreative:{id}; the documented sample pivots by MEMBER_COMPANY and so carries an organization URN.

dateRange.description: UTC calendar day; LinkedIn days are UTC (AAP 0.3.3). Start and end are inclusive; DAILY elements carry start equal to end. The schema page marks start required and end optional.

start.description: Calendar date; year, month (1-12) and day (1-31) as integers.

end.description: Calendar date; year, month (1-12) and day (1-31) as integers.

costInLocalCurrency.description: BigDecimal as a decimal string, in the account currency; parsed to numeric(18,6). Live 202609 responses carry up to 17 decimal places of float residue (for example "19.918330000000001"), so the parser rounds a value with more than 6 decimal places half-even to 6 places; a value that rounds to 10^12 or more is a defect.

impressions.description: long. Impressions for Sponsored Content, sends for Sponsored Messaging; feeds fact_creative_daily.impressions.

landingPageClicks.description: long. Clicks to the creative landing page; feeds fact_creative_daily.landing_page_clicks.

oneClickLeadFormOpens.description: long. Lead form opens; feeds fact_creative_daily.form_opens.

oneClickLeads.description: long. Leads from One Click Lead Gen; feeds fact_creative_daily.leads.

externalWebsiteConversions.description: long, documented default "0"; the sample carries an integer. Feeds fact_creative_daily.website_conversions.

reactions.description: long. Not requested by this product; declared only because the documented sample carries it.

shares.description: long. Not requested by this product; declared only because the documented sample carries it.

likes.description: long. Not requested by this product; declared only because other documented views and the schema page's metrics table carry it.

paging.description: Optional: the documented specific-metrics sample has none, while the first Analytics Finder sample and the live response (2026-10-07) carry {count, links, start}. The endpoint does not paginate; only a rel=next link in links is ever acted on.
